QuestInfo.name: A Weapon Never Leaves Its Owner
QuestInfo.1: #p1201000# tells you that the polearm is acting strange once again and that it might be trying to tell you something. What's the problem this time? You'd better head over to #b#m140000000##k.
QuestInfo.2: #p1201002# told you that a thief came to the island late one night and removed a Red Jade from his body! He asked you to catch the thief and told you that the thief headed toward #m140020300#...
QuestInfo.0: You've hit Lv. 60, and #b#p1201000##k suddenly wants to talk to you. What could she want?

0.1: But first, you must head to #b#m140000000##k. Your #b#p1201001##k is acting weird again. I think it has something to tell you. It might be able to restore your abilities, so please hurry.

yes.0: Anyway, I thought it was really something that a weapon had its own identity, but this weapon gets extremely annoying. It cries, saying that I'm not paying attention to its needs, and now... Oh, please keep this a secret from the Polearm. I don't think it's a good idea to upset the weapon any more than I already have.

no.0: Even if you decide to wait on your Job Advancement after reaching Lv. 60 and save your SP, you won't be able to assign the SP to 3rd job skills. Remember that!

0.0: I see that you've reached Lv. 60. You've still got a long way to go, but compared to when we first met, you've made a lot of progress!

npc.0: Have you still not gone to see the polearm? It lights up like a disco ball, and I can't sleep because of it. Please go see the weapon and calm it down.

1.0: And where did YOU go off, leaving me behind? What? Training? Ah, you are Lv. 60! Ooooh! Quite the improvement from when you couldn't even hear my voice! No wait... that's not what I wanted to say!
